svg.title: One order, seven steps
svg.desc: Four columns: You, Claude, Alpaca (your paper account) and Allocait (your rules). Step 1, you ask Claude to check an order. Step 2, Claude reads your paper account and last prices from Alpaca, and the answer is drawn dashed. Step 3, Claude sends Allocait the order and those prices. Step 4, Allocait returns what the order does to your ranges, drawn dashed because it is returned. Step 5, you read the facts and say yes or no. Step 6, in Claude Code, an installed hook asks you once more; it asks in default and accept-edits modes and refuses in others. Step 7, Claude places the paper order with Alpaca and reads it back, drawn dashed; if you ask, Claude records the fill in Allocait. Lines for steps 3 and 4 pass by the Alpaca column and send nothing to it. Allocait and Alpaca never talk to each other; Claude carries the facts between them. In chat there is no hook. The skill tells Claude to run the check.
